div.div: رَجُلٌ مَحْمُوزُ البَنَانِ , A man strong in the tips, or ends, of the fingers: (S, K, TA:) occurring in a verse of Aboo-Khirásh: (S:) but [SM says,] what I read in a poem of that author is مَحْمُوزُ القِطَاع, meaning, hard and pointed in the arrowheads. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
